question: Among players who weigh more than 200 lbs, list the 10 heaviest with their weight and their height in centimetres rounded to a whole number.
evidence: weight > 200; heaviest refers to weight DESC, ties broken by Player.id; height rounded refers to ROUND(height)
gold_sql: SELECT player_name, weight, ROUND(height) FROM Player WHERE weight > 200 ORDER BY weight DESC, id LIMIT 10

question: In the first five stages of the 2015/2016 season, which league had the most matches that ended in a draw?
evidence: first five stages refers to stage <= 5; draw refers to home_team_goal = away_team_goal; the league of a match is its home team's league; ties broken by league name
gold_sql: SELECT lg.name FROM Match AS m INNER JOIN Team AS home ON m.home_team_api_id = home.team_api_id INNER JOIN Team AS away ON m.away_team_api_id = away.team_api_id INNER JOIN League AS lg ON m.league_id = lg.id INNER JOIN Country AS ct ON m.country_id = ct.id WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' AND m.stage <= 5 AND m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal GROUP BY lg.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, lg.name LIMIT 1

question: Among players who weigh at least 200 lbs and were born between 1990 and 1995, how many are taller than the average height of that group?
evidence: weight >= 200; born between 1990 and 1995 refers to SUBSTR(birthday, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1995'
gold_sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT height FROM Player WHERE weight >= 200 AND SUBSTR(birthday, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1995') SELECT COUNT(*) FROM grp WHERE height > (SELECT AVG(height) FROM grp)

question: Which players with a heading accuracy of at least 80 in a 2015 attribute record are taller than 185 cm, were born in 1991 or later, and prefer their left foot?
evidence: 2015 attribute record refers to SUBSTR(date, 1, 4) = '2015'; heading_accuracy >= 80; height > 185; born in 1991 or later refers to SUBSTR(birthday, 1, 4) >= '1991'; preferred_foot = 'left'
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name FROM Player AS p INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE SUBSTR(pa.date, 1, 4) = '2015' AND pa.heading_accuracy >= 80 AND p.height > 185 AND SUBSTR(p.birthday, 1, 4) >= '1991' AND pa.preferred_foot = 'left'

question: Which league had the most goals in the first three stages of the 2015/2016 season?
evidence: first three stages refers to stage <= 3; goals refers to SUM(home_team_goal + away_team_goal); ties broken by league name
gold_sql: SELECT lg.name FROM Match AS m INNER JOIN Team AS home ON m.home_team_api_id = home.team_api_id INNER JOIN Team AS away ON m.away_team_api_id = away.team_api_id INNER JOIN League AS lg ON m.league_id = lg.id INNER JOIN Country AS ct ON m.country_id = ct.id WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' AND m.stage <= 3 GROUP BY lg.name ORDER BY SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) DESC, lg.name LIMIT 1

question: In the 2009/2010 season, counting only matches played from 1 January 2010, which away team won the most Scotland Premier League matches in which it scored at least two goals?
evidence: 2009/2010 season refers to season = '2009/2010'; from 1 January 2010 refers to date >= '2010-01-01'; away team won refers to away_team_goal > home_team_goal; scored at least two goals refers to away_team_goal >= 2; ties broken by team name
gold_sql: SELECT away.team_long_name FROM Match AS m INNER JOIN Team AS home ON m.home_team_api_id = home.team_api_id INNER JOIN Team AS away ON m.away_team_api_id = away.team_api_id INNER JOIN League AS lg ON m.league_id = lg.id INNER JOIN Country AS ct ON m.country_id = ct.id WHERE m.season = '2009/2010' AND m.date >= '2010-01-01' AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal AND lg.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND m.away_team_goal >= 2 GROUP BY away.team_long_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, away.team_long_name LIMIT 1

question: List any 5 players who had a sprint speed of at least 93 in an attribute record from 2013 to 2015 and were born before 1990.
evidence: from 2013 to 2015 refers to SUBSTR(date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '2013' AND '2015'; sprint_speed >= 93; born before 1990 refers to SUBSTR(birthday, 1, 4) < '1990'
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name FROM Player AS p INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE SUBSTR(pa.date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '2013' AND '2015' AND pa.sprint_speed >= 93 AND SUBSTR(p.birthday, 1, 4) < '1990'

question: Which leagues had at least one match with six or more goals in the first ten stages of the 2015/2016 season?
evidence: first ten stages refers to stage <= 10; six or more goals refers to home_team_goal + away_team_goal >= 6
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT lg.name FROM Match AS m INNER JOIN Team AS home ON m.home_team_api_id = home.team_api_id INNER JOIN Team AS away ON m.away_team_api_id = away.team_api_id INNER JOIN League AS lg ON m.league_id = lg.id INNER JOIN Country AS ct ON m.country_id = ct.id WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' AND m.stage <= 10 AND m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal >= 6

question: Among the 2016 attribute records with an overall rating of at least 75, what percentage belong to left-footed players with a crossing score of at least 75?
evidence: 2016 attribute records refers to SUBSTR(date, 1, 4) = '2016'; overall_rating >= 75; crossing >= 75; left-footed refers to preferred_foot = 'left'; percentage = 100.0 * count of such records / count of all records
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN pa.crossing >= 75 AND pa.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Player AS p INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE SUBSTR(pa.date, 1, 4) = '2016' AND pa.overall_rating >= 75

question: In the first three stages of the 2012/2013 season, which leagues scored more goals than the average league?
evidence: first three stages refers to stage <= 3; a league's goals = SUM(home_team_goal + away_team_goal) over its matches; the average league's goals = total goals / number of leagues with matches in that period
gold_sql: WITH g AS (SELECT lg.name AS league, m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal AS goals FROM Match AS m INNER JOIN Team AS home ON m.home_team_api_id = home.team_api_id INNER JOIN Team AS away ON m.away_team_api_id = away.team_api_id INNER JOIN League AS lg ON m.league_id = lg.id INNER JOIN Country AS ct ON m.country_id = ct.id WHERE m.season = '2012/2013' AND m.stage <= 3) SELECT league FROM g GROUP BY league HAVING SUM(goals) > (SELECT SUM(goals) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT league) FROM g)

question: Which matches played in December 2009 were won by the home team, had more than three goals, and were played in the England Premier League? Give the home team, the away team and the date.
evidence: December 2009 refers to SUBSTR(date, 1, 7) = '2009-12'; won by the home team refers to home_team_goal > away_team_goal; more than three goals refers to home_team_goal + away_team_goal > 3
gold_sql: SELECT home.team_long_name, away.team_long_name, SUBSTR(m.date, 1, 10) FROM Match AS m INNER JOIN Team AS home ON m.home_team_api_id = home.team_api_id INNER JOIN Team AS away ON m.away_team_api_id = away.team_api_id INNER JOIN League AS lg ON m.league_id = lg.id INNER JOIN Country AS ct ON m.country_id = ct.id WHERE SUBSTR(m.date, 1, 7) = '2009-12' AND m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal AND m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal > 3 AND lg.name = 'England Premier League'

question: For the 10 attribute records from 2016 with the highest overall rating, give the player's name, the rating and the player's preferred foot.

question: Among players who weigh under 140 lbs, how many are left-footed or shorter than 170 cm?
evidence: weight < 140; left-footed refers to preferred_foot = 'left'; height < 170; count distinct players
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM Player AS p INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.weight < 140 AND (pa.preferred_foot = 'left' OR p.height < 170)

question: Which teams have a short name starting with the letter L and had a Risky chance creation passing class in their 2015 attributes?

question: For the 5 attribute records from 2010 with the highest overall rating, give the player's name, the rating and the player's birthday.

question: For the teams whose build-up play passing class was Long or Short in their 2015 attributes, give the team's long name and, when its build-up play speed class was Balanced, its short name.
evidence: 2015 attributes refers to SUBSTR(Team_Attributes.date, 1, 4) = '2015'; buildUpPlayPassingClass IN ('Long', 'Short'); buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Balanced'; short name refers to team_short_name, NULL otherwise
gold_sql: SELECT t.team_long_name, CASE WHEN ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Balanced' THEN t.team_short_name END FROM Team AS t INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE SUBSTR(ta.date, 1, 4) = '2015' AND ta.buildUpPlayPassingClass IN ('Long', 'Short')

question: For each match played on 8 August 2015, give the home team, the away team and the country the match was played in.
evidence: played on 8 August 2015 refers to SUBSTR(date, 1, 10) = '2015-08-08'; country refers to Country.name
gold_sql: SELECT home.team_long_name, away.team_long_name, ct.name FROM Match AS m INNER JOIN Team AS home ON m.home_team_api_id = home.team_api_id INNER JOIN Team AS away ON m.away_team_api_id = away.team_api_id INNER JOIN League AS lg ON m.league_id = lg.id INNER JOIN Country AS ct ON m.country_id = ct.id WHERE SUBSTR(m.date, 1, 10) = '2015-08-08'
